description: Beta v3 storage forecast, issued 2026-10-21 (data cutoff 2026-10-17). EXPERIMENTAL: a shipping-responsive beta layer over the issued v2026-10-15 forecast, which remains unchanged and authoritative. The probability-weighted central line is the beta odds (holds 0.1526 / standoff 0.4989 / lapses 0.3486, frozen at issue from shipping data through 2026-10-17) applied to three conditional paths — two of which (holds, lapses) are identical to the issued v2 paths and one of which (the standoff branch) allows partial Gulf recovery through alternative routes while attacks continue: a DIFFERENT path from the published standoff line (September level + non-Gulf, no Gulf increment). World production in the beta standoff reaches 105.30 mb/d by Dec 2027 — between the issued v2 standoff (103.30) and the EIA baseline (111.49). Reference frame: zero = the frozen August 2026 anchor (−507 mb vs end-Feb 2026); the paths restart at the observed September (−509). October 2026 is partly elapsed at issue; November 2026 is the first clean month. A new observation issues a NEW dated vintage; this file is frozen. Method: /beta/ (research/beta-forecast-v3-2026-10-21.md). Dashboard: the 'Beta storage forecast (v3)' checkbox, off by default.

odds.spec: beta odds spec v3 = the reviewed candidate filter (branch_filter_candidate.py), unchanged — prior 0.10/0.50/0.40; volume lognormal 15.0/8.5/2.0 sigma 0.35 w=1.0; transits Poisson 20/10/2 w=0.5 (hypothesis); tankers Poisson 0.2/1.5/4.0 w=0.5; brent NOT a state observation; the documented state->horizon transition table

inputs.brent_note: context only — not a state observation in the beta odds

odds.mapping_note: The HORIZON row is the issue-date estimate of the corridor regime for the forecast horizon; the state->horizon transition is already folded in ONCE. It weights the three scenario paths with a FIXED weight across the whole horizon — no time-varying re-transition (that would double-count the transition). The HORIZON is NOT a confidence interval over the storage lines.
